notes: Project compatibility-entry coverage includes basic remote object references, synonym statements, explain plan statements, national string literals, national q-quoted strings, session-state statements, and INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE RETURNING INTO with N>=1 targets paired by ordinal with exactly N colon-prefixed host binds. BULK COLLECT, receivers other than colon-prefixed binds, and unequal list lengths are excluded; the same insert_column patch inserts both sides. All 220 cases have status = "final" and contain 791 independent patches. This is executable project-contract evidence, not a claim that Vastbase server documentation defines the same syntax scope.

Covers MySQL-compatible syntax through an explicit Vastbase mode, including backtick identifiers, national string literals, parameterized LIMIT, CTE, window-function, scalar-function, common-type, ROLLBACK, SELECT alias lineage, MySQL INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE modifier cases, REPLACE base forms, CREATE TABLE column attributes, table options, partition tails, index-hint placement, and session-state statements.
Covers PostgreSQL-compatible syntax through an explicit Vastbase mode, including national string literals and session-state statements.

Covers SQL Server-compatible syntax through an explicit Vastbase mode, including TOP PERCENT/WITH TIES, nested TOP, FOR JSON suffix restoration, table/query hint public restoration, bitwise expressions, !</!> comparisons, pipe concatenation, LIKE bracket wildcards, AT TIME ZONE, IS DISTINCT FROM, OR predicate lineage, basic SET statements, session-state statements, basic CONNECT BY, and basic forms of mixed-model official entries. Paired insert_column applies only to sink OUTPUT INTO with an explicit non-empty sink-column list and initially equal OUTPUT-target/sink-column counts; it atomically inserts both sides at the same ordinal. Legally unequal OUTPUT lists remain parseable and deparseable but do not support paired insertion; client OUTPUT and OUTPUT INTO without explicit sink columns are excluded from this mutation. All 604 cases have status = "final" and contain 1850 independent patches. Three cases cover 8-to-8 pairs for INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE plus head, middle, and tail insertions that produce 9-to-9 pairs. START WITH, PRIOR, NOCYCLE, and CONNECT_BY_ROOT are outside this mode's current boundary. This is executable project-contract evidence, not a claim that Vastbase server documentation defines the same syntax scope.
